rubric_items.reason: Modules, APIs and tables are listed, but the symbols that carry the changed detail response (appointmentRepo DetailRow, web AppointmentDetail type) are not named.
Every module, API and table id exists in the generated facts and is cited. The page-to-route mapping (C3, C4) is inferred from names only.

Jobs (none) and the booking path are covered. Other readers of the extended GET detail response are flagged as a risk but never identified. The source of the hospital time zone on the web side is not traced.

The api and GET-detail 'changed' statuses rest on the cited answer A-04. The other statuses are justified by schema facts. The exclusive claims (only client.ts, no jobs, only the patient's page) are cited to the context.
The artifact is clear and grouped well, and the summary names the main risks. The impacted list is not ordered by risk.

findings.text: The extended GET /api/appointments/:id response needs changes in appointmentRepo DetailRow (API) and the AppointmentDetail type (web). Neither is listed. The other readers of the detail response are named as a risk but never identified.
